verdicts.quote: The default schedule has three steps, at 1, 7 and 14 days after the due date ... (C-3) No reminder is sent before the first step date
A fully paid invoice gets no reminder from the moment the payment is recorded (C-13: A void or cancelled invoice gets no reminder; C-15: negative because of a credit, gets no message)
verdicts.missing: Disputes are only stopped by a manual per-invoice mark (U-8), not automatically; nothing says what happens to an invoice on a payment plan.

verdicts.quote: An invoice of 1,000.00 USD with 400.00 USD paid, once overdue, gets reminders showing 600.00 USD and not 1,000.00 USD.

However often the system runs in a day, however often it restarts, the customer gets one message for each step of an invoice and never two for the same step. (C-43: two copies ... one message per step)
A fully paid invoice gets no reminder from the moment the payment is recorded. If payment is recorded at 08:59 and the send time is 09:00, no reminder for that invoice arrives
A failed delivery is tried again, for 3 attempts in all, at least 1 hour apart, within the step date
verdicts.missing: Escalation to a person: the failure is only recorded in the history ("the owner can see it"); no alert or notification when sends keep failing.

verdicts.quote: each overdue unpaid invoice that has a step date already behind it gets exactly one reminder at the first send time, and invoices not yet overdue get none.
Step dates and the send time are counted in a configured time zone, UTC by default
verdicts.missing: The zone is a single system setting, not the customer's local time; nothing on weekends or holidays.

verdicts.quote: A reminder shows the invoice number, the outstanding amount with its currency, and the due date
verdicts.missing: How the amount and currency are formatted for the recipient's locale (separators, symbol vs code).

verdicts.quote: An overdue unpaid invoice whose customer has no usable email address is skipped, and the owner can see why
verdicts.missing: What happens when an address bounces after a reminder is handed to the mail service.

verdicts.quote: A reminder is sent only to the contact address of the invoice's own customer
verdicts.missing: Which address(es) are used when the customer has more than one billing contact.

verdicts.quote: For each reminder handled, the history shows the time, the address used, the step and the outcome (sent, failed or skipped), and for a failure or skip the reason.
A reminder carries the payment instructions or payment link the invoice has, when it has one
verdicts.missing: Whether the payment link expires and what happens if it has.

verdicts.quote: Owner: the business user who issues invoices and manages the reminder settings.
verdicts.missing: Any access rule for who may configure, and who may send a reminder by hand (manual send is not specified).

verdicts.quote: Turning reminders off stops all sending from that moment
verdicts.missing: Per-customer off switch (only per-invoice exists), preview or dry run, and manual resend.

verdicts.quote: the history shows the time, the address used, the step and the outcome (sent, failed or skipped)
verdicts.missing: A view of upcoming reminders, and a cross-invoice view of failures rather than per-invoice history.

verdicts.quote: A reminder that is due is sent within 1 hour of its send time, if the system is running (C-39: the step is recorded as failed and is not sent later)
Reminders never change an invoice's data ... (C-40) creating and editing invoices and recording payments all work and give the same results
